question: Can the unchanged finite R10V recovery-and-walking task satisfy all six declared Godot/Jolt cells when the distinct production campaign uses the explicitly bound R10X native Windows process observer? Preserve the positive R10W pair and its failed CIM-bound qualification. No physical or measured-predicate change is permitted.

selection.rule: The next three consecutive prefix phases after the conservatively exposed 240-246 interval; no outcome-based selection.
selection.seed_to_phase_rule: The common walking-prefix phase is seed modulo 360 for every limb; preserve all setup, native memory, frame and fresh-session semantics.
selection.historical_inventory_rule: All 83 retained development-smoke declarations present at selection, including declarations without a physical launch, are bound. Explicit contexts carry phase; legacy seed 40200 carries phase 240. R10W added only its fresh development phase 245; its refused zero-world qualification opened no held-out cell. Conservatively treat every physically declared development phase as exposed.
selection.held_out_scope: Future physical outcomes at these three exact phase fixtures. The public clocks have already been enumerated in zero-world startup work; no unseen algorithmic-input, random-sample or all-phase physical claim is made.
selection.successor_seed_rule: Use distinct seeds 51007-51009, each 360 above the unopened R10W declaration, preserving still-unmeasured prefix phases 247-249. R10W held-out execution authority never existed and no cell opened. The new development identity 42445 explicitly maps to exposed phase 245. Neither population reuses a physical child or baseline.

controller_composition.phase_offset_semantics: The actual native initial-memory array order assigns offsets index * 90 within the 360-command gait cycle. This order differs from the compiled contact-site/display order; preserve it throughout the session.
controller_composition.stance_identity_correction: R10G composition.stance full ID named the different prone-to-standing V7. The actual V20 mapping in recovery_candidate_stance_profiles_v6.json selects stance_handoff_controller_v7. Preserve the old contract and correct the full name here; no executed controller change.
controller_composition.no_kick_hold_note: The hold is its own finalized V50 session because the anchored law height blend and the startup reference-velocity scale are keyed to memory creation time; a prelude inside the walking memory would silently remove V50 startup easing.
controller_composition.recovery_component_reuse: R10V preserves the complete R10T conditional V50 hold and native control behavior. Its distinct population and host audit contract repair workflow finalization only.

native_interaction.provenance: Unchanged R10F native interaction and source-measured first completed-step effect.

finite_walking_observable.cycle: A retained preparation release, actual native post-step absence during scheduled swing, then actual supported stance after the swing; use synchronized measured capsule endpoints. The independent reader must bind every request, response, clock, contact and memory transition.
finite_walking_observable.cutoff: First completion of all four measured planned cycles with all four feet in supported scheduled stance, then exactly 120 zero-amplitude and zero-speed commands. Failure to finish within 1600 walking commands is a bounded negative.
finite_walking_observable.threshold_provenance: The 3-sample airborne dwell, 12 mm foot advance and 20 mm body advance are unchanged magnitudes from the original development walking evaluator. The new observable identifies planned gait cycles rather than treating every stance contact loss as an intended step. No old campaign is regraded.
finite_walking_observable.body_advance_measurement: Measured torso position immediately before the first walking command to the final post-stop native torso position, projected onto the initial anatomical horizontal forward axis. The neutral-entry segment is excluded.

settled_tail.provenance: Unchanged V49/V50 prospective cycle-stop conditions; require every final 30 observation, not an average.

whole_walking_envelope.provenance: Unchanged original finite development walking limits. Native engine health, bounded joint-only actuation, identity, contact truth and the complete recovery energy invariants also remain mandatory.

preserved_task.post_recovery_hold_rule: Preserve the exact bound R10V task: direct walking for already-ready recovery; only the declared upright horizontal-speed case may use a separate zero-amplitude V50 hold, at most 240 commands and 30 consecutive ready samples. No partial/prone hold expansion.
preserved_task.hold_budget_decision: Preserve all current budgets. Phase 245 used 106 of 240 post-recovery hold commands; this exposed result does not estimate success at the new phases.
preserved_task.allowed_changes: Distinct campaign seed/authority, profile/source-key dispatch, native Windows process observation, launcher, durable host, report identity, independent reader integration and closure/adoption only. Explicitly select the bound native observer in the actual L15 launcher invocation; no CIM fallback. Preserve controller algorithms, DLL, native stepping, measured predicates and physical budgets. Never rewrite R10V/R10W consumed keys or reopen their populations.

coverage_adequacy.prior_physical_coverage: The committed R10V closure contains five original valid positives: no-kick, upright with bounded hold, upright direct, partial direct and prone direct. It establishes the prerequisite and exposed branch coverage only; it supplies no new baseline or held-out outcome.
coverage_adequacy.changed_campaign_paths: New campaign identity and source/runtime key, actual native observer selection for the Godot console/worker ancestry, multi-pair scheduling, durable ownership, original capture/replay/publication and finite aggregation require affected-path controls and one fresh full-horizon development pair. The 13-test native component is prerequisite evidence only.

fresh_development_ghost.adequacy: One fresh matched pair at exposed phase 245 is the smallest full-horizon population covering both campaign roles, actual Godot native process ancestry under the new observer, conditional upright hold, walking, stopping, child retirement, replay and publication. R10V retains five positive branch records and R10W retains its positive pair, but neither supplies a fresh child or baseline. Full native-observer and scheduling refusal controls precede launch.

coverage_adequacy.integration_change_rule: If implementation changes construction, control, adapter, stepping, schedule, capture or a branch beyond the declared campaign boundary, declare additional coverage before any world. Do not infer coverage from labels or use a held-out cell for debugging.
coverage_adequacy.zero_world_startup: The retained R10S 1800-case V56 startup sweep is historical context, not current qualification or 360 physically generated handoff states. Qualify the complete current source/runtime key and affected startup interfaces; any changed startup dependency needs its own appropriate revalidation.

execution_contract.qualification_key: Bind every transitive source, runtime, candidate, task, reader and campaign dependency. Explicitly excluded result/authority/bookkeeping outputs must be bound by the committed authority graph; do not exclude executable inputs.
execution_contract.lifetime: The original durable host owns the entire campaign and its exact process tree independently of the interactive caller. Bind starts, deadlines, original exits, stdout/stderr, replay and publication; missing completion stays incomplete.
execution_contract.verification_structure: Validate expensive prerequisite evidence in bounded qualification stages and bind their complete bytes/key. Keep execution, child-reader and historical-closure verification acyclic; no validator may create a world, recursively authorize a prerequisite, or substitute a new receipt for an original one.
execution_contract.timing: Retain 1740 seconds per physical child and 900 seconds per native replay. Declare separate host, wrapper, final-audit and campaign wall ceilings from measured component timings before qualification; these cannot alter native timing, horizons or result thresholds.
execution_contract.ordering: Run seeds 51007, 51008, 51009 in that order, with a fresh no-kick child then a fresh kicked child for each. Behavioral negatives do not suppress later declared cells.
execution_contract.infrastructure_failure: A failure preventing safe bounded ownership or launch may leave later cells unopened; retain that status and the original failure. Any negative, invalid, incomplete or unopened cell prevents acceptance and consumes the campaign; no replacement or retry.
execution_contract.decision: The conjunction of six execution-valid finite-task positives under the bound unchanged evaluator. Record actual recovery branches; infer no unobserved branch, causal superiority, robustness or cross-engine equivalence.

known_risks: Physical settling, recovery branch and walking at phases 247-249 remain unmeasured.
The five development positives and deterministic startup sweep do not predict six held-out positives.
Any failed cell burns the single-use population; preserve every original outcome and unopened cell.
A positive decision supports only this exact finite Godot/Jolt task, not arbitrary pushes, morphology, continuous phase coverage or cross-engine recovery.

The native observer has component evidence only; actual campaign dispatch and Godot process ancestry still require fresh qualified route coverage. Aggregate host handle counts are diagnostic, not a physical or qualification predicate.
